text:
alisa: Quick cross-team PRD check-in: Dedicated autoscaling canary + rollout criteria ready for review. Goal: safe rollout with predictable latency and cost. Please flag missing acceptance criteria or edge cases.

matt: Thx — quick q: perf targets? p50/p95/p99 tokens latency budgets? also need traffic shaping plan for canary.

alisa: p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 180ms, p99 <= 400ms for 1k-token seq on dedicated pools. Canary <= 5% traffic for 24h.

sandeep: infra notes: canary must run on dedicated pool variant (no multi-tenant), autoscaler cooldown 5m, fallback to smaller model if mem pressure. What about cold start SLO?

alisa: cold start SLO: <2s for warm GPUs, <10s for cold VMs. Documented in PRD under "runtime constraints".

rachel: Console UX: need canary toggle + rollout timeline + rollback button. Also surface active canary % and error rate trend. I'll add mock.

tyler: Security checklist: KMS key usage for model weights in private deploys, audit logs enabled for rollout actions, RBAC: only infra+pm can start canary.

anna: Sales note: customer asks for blackout dates (no deploys during their sales events). Need opt-out flag per-customer for dedicated tenants.

matt: Edge case: model variant mismatch between fallback and primary -> config must include model-compatibility matrix; devops will reject incompatible fallbacks.

alisa: Acceptance criteria draft (quick):
```
- Canary starts at 1% -> 5% over 3 increments
- Monitor: latency, errors, token cost, tail latency
- Automatic rollback if error rate > 2x baseline OR p99 > 2x target for 15m
- Manual approval required before >25% traffic
- Docs + console: rollout UI + opt-out flag
- Security & audit requirements met
```

sandeep: +1. Also add metric: memory pressure >85% -> scale down or fallback.

rachel: UX acceptance: mock in Figma linked: https://figma.com/some/link (placeholder). Need labels and copy for rollback reasons.

tyler: I'll send a short checklist for compliance sign-off. Expect to need privacy review for telemetry.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy queued by @alisa (ID cny-2026-04-15-01) — no action until approvals met :information_source:

alisa: Going to update PRD with these edits. Requesting explicit sign-off by EOD Thu from eng, infra, sec, design. @matt @sandeep @tyler @rachel please react with :white_check_mark: when you sign off or drop blockers.
